summary: Caledonia Mining Corporation Plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 22, 2026, disclosing receipt of a TR-1 major holdings notification from BlackRock, Inc. Under the UK-style disclosure regime (the US equivalent of a Schedule 13G/13D amendment), BlackRock reported that on September 18, 2026 it crossed a notification threshold, with voting rights attached to shares falling to 4.90% from 5.11%, while financial instruments (securities lending and cash-settled CFDs) rose to 2.08% from 1.99%, for a combined 6.98% versus 7.10% previously, or 1,350,254 voting rights. This passive stake adjustment is not a special situation; no board recommendation, advisor, price, premium or deal terms were disclosed. Watch for further TR-1 filings and any shift toward activist intent.
